text.content:
The netrunner who broke the Net.

Role: Netrunner (dead)
Known for: The DataKrash

The most brilliant netrunner of his age, who believed information should be free. He hid the DataKrash inside the Net's standard algorithms as a dead man's switch; when he was killed in 2022, it went off, scrambling corporate data and loosing his R.A.B.I.D.S. into the Net.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.12
